title: Operational BI: today’s decision, the operations dashboard

videos.script: It is eleven on a Wednesday morning, and fourteen trucks are out of Varanda's warehouse in Contagem. {{trucks}} Marcos coordinates the deliveries, and he has one question. Which of these trucks needs me now? A chart of the month cannot answer it. Neither can an average: the routes are nineteen minutes behind on average, and that hides the one that is seventy-four. {{levels}} This lesson is the first of three about the speed of a decision. Today's decisions are taken in minutes, by people on the floor, and they need a different screen from the one the directors read. {{board}} You will see the board Lívia built for Marcos. Exceptions first, everything else made small, and the time of the data in the header. {{sheet}} Then you count, in your spreadsheet, how many alerts the same morning would have raised at three different thresholds. Seven, three or one. Choosing between them is a business decision. {{frozen}} Last, the morning the data stopped arriving, and the board kept looking calm for an hour and three quarters.
